page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Ezon." in the left note (possibly "Eson."); "Maffonius" in the left note (print is blurred); "quewm" in the summary heading; "Pape" in the summary heading; "Pontificy" (possibly Pontificij). The date "cIↄcccvii" was read as MCCCVII (1307). The catchword "ficem" completes the split word "Pontificem" at the foot. The page-end line "Ponti-" is a hyphenated line break. Digitiser's stamp "Digitized by Google" at the bottom right and a dark mark at the top right were left out.
